mcp-abap-adt/search.semantic: Who calls this method or function module (BAPI), and who uses this class, table or CDS view: the where-used list of an object.

description: [read-only] Lists where the object named by object_type and object_name is used — a class, interface, program, include, function group, function module (BAPI included), package, table, structure, domain, data element or CDS DDL source: the objects that use, call or reference it, with type and package. Required: object_type*, object_name*. Optional: function_group_name (FUNCTION_MODULE), max_results (default 100). Response: JSON. Runs on an ABAP session of its own. Optional timeout (seconds): when it passes, the read is cancelled, its ABAP session logged off, and the system stays as it was. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a client's cancel ends only the client's wait, and SAP runs the read on. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

function_group_name.description: Function group of the function module (FUNCTION_MODULE).

max_results.description: Maximum number of referencing objects returned.

object_type.description: Type of the object whose usages are listed.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the answer: a whole number, at least 1, no default — without it the call waits until SAP answers. When it passes, the read is cancelled (its ABAP session is logged off) and the call answers that nothing was changed. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a cancel does nothing to SAP.

name: HandlerWhereUsed
